description:
We are Team Rudra, a group of passionate and enthusiastic young innovators interested in space, science, technology, and problem-solving. We believe that creativity, teamwork, and innovation can turn great ideas into meaningful solutions.

Our goal is to explore real-world challenges, think beyond limits, and develop innovative ideas inspired by space science and NASA's open data. We are eager to learn new technologies, share knowledge, and work together to create something impactful.
